ticker_news.title: US Stocks Set To Open On A Positive Note As Trump's Second White House Term Kicks Off: Tesla, Apple, Netflix Among Stocks In Focus
ticker_news.description: US stocks are expected to open on a positive note as Donald Trump begins his second term as president. Key stocks in focus include Tesla, Apple, Netflix, and others. The market is optimistic about earnings growth prospects for US companies compared to their European counterparts.
ticker_news.author: Rounak Jain

ticker_news.title: Tesla Cybertruck Discounts: What They Mean for Stock Price
ticker_news.description: Tesla's Cybertruck discounts suggest tepid demand, indicating increased competition and a likely decline in total vehicle deliveries. Analysts remain hopeful for Tesla's success in 2025, but the consensus sentiment is a Hold, with a price target lagging behind the action.
ticker_news.author: Marketbeat.Com
